rounds.summary: Full independent review against the actual code at dc65e03. Verdict REWORK, eight findings. F-1 MAJOR: REQ-AUTHOR/plan.md/D-2 author-plate formula contradicted the required behavior — 'previous non-system message' would plate the second A in A,ME,A; fixed semantics: the tracker holds the previous FOREIGN non-system author, own messages never update it. F-2 MINOR: plan.md referenced a non-existent message.scss (message styles live in messenger.scss; the file is outside the write-set — a literal worker would violate ownership). F-3 MINOR: REQ-BOTMARK lacked the .lower() normalization of the canonical idiom (services/chats.py:569-571) — an upper-case email would silently yield False. F-4 MINOR: the pane swipe is wired on the messenger root where all three Modals render inline — a right-swipe over an open dialog would deselect the chat; a touchstart-inside-[data-testid=modal] guard with a negative pin is required. F-5 NOTE: developer-overview claimed 'no touch degradation' for the hover-scoped pencil underlay — dishonest wording (the affordance disappears entirely on touch, tap remains) accepted per operator U3. F-6 NOTE: FE budget tight for 23 files — raised later. F-7 NOTE: left:70px chip needs a desktop glance in the live smoke. F-8 NOTE: remediationMode ask vs D-10 delegation seam needs an explicit decisions line. Verified en route: Block._addEvents attaches arbitrary event names and re-attaches across re-renders (touch wiring feasible); jsdom Event + Object.defineProperty(changedTouches) feasible; the >2-members gate reads the full chatUsers endpoint (not the capped GET /chats brief); 1-1 AI chat keeps the chip without the plate; kebab inherits the archived cross filter; profile-settings-item is a flex row (margin-left:auto works); is_bot is additive into GET /chats briefs — documented as risk; coverage 8 operator items ↔ 10 REQ closed, write-set exact.

Confirm round. All eight round-1 findings verified applied and mutually consistent (F-1 formula in REQ/plan/D-2 with explicit A,ME,A / A,B,A examples; F-2 message.scss removed; F-3 .lower() pinned; F-4 modal guard + negative pin — additionally verified .modal_closed{display:none} makes the selector behaviorally safe; F-5 honest wording; F-6 budgets 40000/110000; F-7 desktop chip in the smoke; F-8 D-10 ask-seam line). CLI completeness-check PASS (digest bb301345…). Residuals: F-R2-1 MAJOR — the machine-readable gate texts (AC-BOTMARK/AC-PROCESS statements, finalAuditGates, validation.commands, WS-BE-BOT launchGate/qualityFloor/plannedItems, acceptance-criteria.md) still demanded the unreachable 'npm run verify:backend exit 0' while D-11 records the stand seam (339 passed / 4 known POSIX-only ingestion failures, canonical bash invocation) — journal prose cannot reshape the machine contract. F-R2-2 MINOR: EV-3 did not mention the desktop chip check now required by AC-HINT. F-R2-3 NOTE: absolute 8.3 user path committed in the public journal — neutralize to a placeholder. Verdict REWORK (editorial only; scope, write-set, DAG and technical decisions unchanged).

Freeze-gating round. F-R2-1 closed fully and consistently: validation.commands now carries the canonical PYTHON_BIN=<backend-venv-python> bash backend/verify.sh invocation plus a new validation.backendGateRule with the deterministic D-11 verdict (PASS = everything green except exactly the 4 known POSIX-only ingestion failures in tests/unit/ingestion/test_converter.py, identical before/after, outside the write-set; zero new/deleted; full output in evidence); the D-11 qualification is carried by WS-BE-BOT launchGate (baseline numbers), qualityFloor, plannedItems, AC-BOTMARK/AC-PROCESS statements, REQ-PROCESS description and both finalAuditGates lines; acceptance-criteria.md and plan.md mirror the same rule — no literal 'verify:backend exit 0' remains in any backend gate. F-R2-2 closed: EV-3 names both the 390px stories smoke and the desktop chip check. F-R2-3 closed: D-11 path neutralized to a placeholder (exact stand path only in the operator runbook and evidence log). Residual F-R3-1 NOTE (stale gate name in developer-overview narrative) verified already fixed by grep — no open findings. Coverage 8 operator items ↔ 10 REQ ↔ 10 AC ↔ EV-1/2/3 ↔ finalAuditGates closed and re-verified against code; write-set exact; technical formulas (author-run tracker, modal guard, is_bot with .lower(), minmax clamp) correct and testable; budgets raised; gates executable on the stand; CLI completeness-check PASS (digest 9fbd1097…). Verdict READY_TO_FREEZE.
